headline: Google Pixel event set for August 12
summary: Google announces its next Pixel launch event on August 12. The event will take place in the evening.
details: Google will announce the next generation of its Pixel devices on August 12. The event will take place in the evening, allowing attendees to participate without taking time off work.

This year's Pixel event is expected to be more subdued due to memory shortages and rising consumer electronics prices. Base models of the new Pixel phones are expected to start at 256GB, with no 128GB variant available.
The new Pixel phones are expected to have an updated Tensor processor, although the updates appear to be modest. The company is reportedly planning to charge more for the new phones.
caption:
Google's next Pixel event is on August 12. What's new?

Google will announce the next generation of its Pixel devices on August 12. The event will take place in the evening, allowing attendees to participate without taking time off work.

This year's Pixel event is expected to be more subdued due to memory shortages and rising consumer electronics prices. Base models of the new Pixel phones are expected to start at 256GB, with no 128GB variant available.

The new Pixel phones are expected to have an updated Tensor processor, although the updates appear to be modest. The company is reportedly planning to charge more for the new phones.
